text.text: The thirty-seven TAIGA materials range from 100 durability basalt to nihilite with 950 durability and 10 attack.
Look up any blade blank in JEI to browse every Blade Forging entry, each labelled with durability, attack and material tier.
A finished blade lists its material, durability and attack in its tooltip.
To retune the numbers, edit the TAIGA material data and rerun tools/gen_tsb_materials.py.
